title: Lucky Thirteen Dessert Lemon Berry Pie 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Lemon Berry Pie from Lucky Thirteen’s irresistible Dessert Collection is a mouth-watering American dessert full of zesty lemon flavour, warm, buttery pastry and the sweet-sharp tang of fresh berries. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
